requirements_text:
# Library Management System

A city library with 12 branches wants one system for its catalogue, loans and members.

## Functional requirements
FR-01: Members can search the catalogue by title, author, subject or ISBN.
FR-02: Members can see whether a copy is available at each branch.
FR-03: Members can place a hold on a book that is currently on loan.
FR-04: Librarians check books out and in by scanning the member card and the book barcode.
FR-05: Members can renew a loan online up to two times.
FR-06: The system emails members three days before a due date and again when a loan is overdue.
FR-07: Librarians can add, edit and withdraw books and individual copies.
FR-08: The system calculates overdue fines, and members can pay them online by card.
FR-09: Librarians can register new members and suspend existing ones.
FR-10: Administrators can see a monthly report of loans per branch.

## Non-functional requirements
NFR-01: Catalogue search responds within 1 second with 200 concurrent users.
NFR-02: All 12 branches are served by a single central installation.
NFR-03: A member's personal data is visible only to staff of the member's home branch and to administrators.
NFR-04: Card payments are handled by an external payment provider; the library never stores card numbers.

requirements_text:
# Car Sales Marketplace

An online marketplace where private sellers and dealers list used vehicles and buyers search, contact sellers and reserve a vehicle with a deposit. Operates in the EU.

## Functional requirements
FR-01: Buyers can search listings by free text and filter by make, model, year, price range, mileage, fuel type, body type, distance from a postcode and seller type, with the number of matching listings shown next to every filter value.
FR-02: Buyers can open a listing page with up to 40 photos, an optional 360-degree walk-around video and the full vehicle specification.
FR-03: Private sellers and dealers can create, edit, pause and delete their listings.
FR-04: Listing attributes depend on the vehicle category: cars, motorcycles, vans, trucks and caravans each have their own fields (for example payload for vans, number of berths for caravans), and administrators can add categories and fields without a code release.
FR-05: Sellers upload photos and videos; the platform generates thumbnails and web-optimised versions automatically.
FR-06: Buyers can save a search and receive an email or push notification when a new matching listing is published.
FR-07: Buyers can message a seller through in-platform chat; the conversation history is kept per listing.
FR-08: A buyer can reserve a vehicle by paying a refundable deposit by card; the listing is then shown as reserved for 48 hours.
FR-09: If the seller cancels, or the reservation expires without a sale, the deposit is refunded automatically.
FR-10: Dealers can bulk-import and update their inventory from a CSV file or through a REST API feed.
FR-11: The platform checks each listing's VIN with an external vehicle-history provider and shows a summary of the report on the listing.
FR-12: Buyers can request a financing quote from partner lenders directly from the listing page.
FR-13: Buyers and sellers register and sign in with email and password, or with a Google or Apple account.
FR-14: Buyers can review a dealer after a completed purchase.
FR-15: Moderators review listings flagged by users and can suspend a listing or an account.
FR-16: Dealers have a dashboard showing views, saves and enquiries per listing per day.
FR-17: Administrators can view and export the complete history of every deposit payment and refund.
FR-18: When a seller creates a listing, the platform suggests a price range based on comparable vehicles sold on the platform.
FR-19: Users can download a copy of all personal data the platform holds about them.
FR-20: Users can delete their account, after which the platform erases their personal data.

## Non-functional requirements
NFR-01: Search results, including the per-filter counts, are returned within 300 ms at the 95th percentile over at least 2 million active listings.
NFR-02: The platform stores at least 40 TB of photos and video, growing by about 1 TB per month.
NFR-03: Listing photos load within 1 second for users anywhere in Europe.
NFR-04: Deposit payments and refunds are atomic: a deposit is never captured without the listing being reserved, and is never refunded twice.
NFR-05: Every deposit payment, refund and reservation status change is kept in an immutable audit trail for 7 years.
NFR-06: Card data never touches the platform's servers; card payments are processed by a PCI DSS compliant payment provider.
NFR-07: When an account is deleted, the user's personal data is erased from every store, including search indexes, media storage, chat history, caches and backups, within 30 days (GDPR Article 17). Payment records needed for the audit trail are kept but pseudonymised.
NFR-08: The platform supports 5,000 concurrent users and peaks of 300 search requests per second.
NFR-09: Search and listing pages are available 99.9% of each month.
NFR-10: All personal data is stored and processed inside the EU.
NFR-11: Saved-search notifications are delivered within 5 minutes of a matching listing being published.
NFR-12: A dealer feed of up to 10,000 listings is processed within 15 minutes without slowing down search for buyers.
NFR-13: Dealer dashboard statistics may be up to 1 hour old.

requirements_text:
# Car Sales Marketplace

An online marketplace where private sellers and dealers list used vehicles and buyers search, contact sellers and reserve a vehicle with a deposit. Operates in the EU.

## Functional requirements
FR-01: Buyers can search listings by free text and filter by make, model, year, price range, mileage, fuel type, body type, distance from a postcode and seller type, with the number of matching listings shown next to every filter value.
FR-02: Buyers can open a listing page with up to 40 photos, an optional 360-degree walk-around video and the full vehicle specification.
FR-03: Private sellers and dealers can create, edit, pause and delete their listings.
FR-04: Listing attributes depend on the vehicle category: cars, motorcycles, vans, trucks and caravans each have their own fields (for example payload for vans, number of berths for caravans), and administrators can add categories and fields without a code release.
FR-05: Sellers upload photos and videos; the platform generates thumbnails and web-optimised versions automatically.
FR-06: Buyers can save a search and receive an email or push notification when a new matching listing is published.
FR-07: Buyers can message a seller through in-platform chat; the conversation history is kept per listing.
FR-08: A buyer can reserve a vehicle by paying a refundable deposit by card; the listing is then shown as reserved for 48 hours.
FR-09: If the seller cancels, or the reservation expires without a sale, the deposit is refunded automatically.
FR-10: Dealers can bulk-import and update their inventory from a CSV file or through a REST API feed.
FR-11: The platform checks each listing's VIN with an external vehicle-history provider and shows a summary of the report on the listing.
FR-12: Buyers can request a financing quote from partner lenders directly from the listing page.
FR-13: Buyers and sellers register and sign in with email and password, or with a Google or Apple account.
FR-14: Buyers can review a dealer after a completed purchase.
FR-15: Moderators review listings flagged by users and can suspend a listing or an account.
FR-16: Dealers have a dashboard showing views, saves and enquiries per listing per day.
FR-17: Administrators can view and export the complete history of every deposit payment and refund.
FR-18: When a seller creates a listing, the platform suggests a price range based on comparable vehicles sold on the platform.
FR-19: Users can download a copy of all personal data the platform holds about them.
FR-20: Users can delete their account, after which the platform erases their personal data.

## Non-functional requirements
NFR-01: Search results, including the per-filter counts, are returned within 300 ms at the 95th percentile over at least 2 million active listings.
NFR-02: The platform stores at least 40 TB of photos and video, growing by about 1 TB per month.
NFR-03: Listing photos load within 1 second for users anywhere in Europe.
NFR-04: Deposit payments and refunds are atomic: a deposit is never captured without the listing being reserved, and is never refunded twice.
NFR-05: Every deposit payment, refund and reservation status change is kept in an immutable audit trail for 7 years.
NFR-06: Card data never touches the platform's servers; card payments are processed by a PCI DSS compliant payment provider.
NFR-07: When an account is deleted, the user's personal data is erased from every store, including search indexes, media storage, chat history, caches and backups, within 30 days (GDPR Article 17). Payment records needed for the audit trail are kept but pseudonymised.
NFR-08: The platform supports 5,000 concurrent users and peaks of 300 search requests per second.
NFR-09: Search and listing pages are available 99.9% of each month.
NFR-10: All personal data is stored and processed inside the EU.
NFR-11: Saved-search notifications are delivered within 5 minutes of a matching listing being published.
NFR-12: A dealer feed of up to 10,000 listings is processed within 15 minutes without slowing down search for buyers.
NFR-13: Dealer dashboard statistics may be up to 1 hour old.

requirements_text:
# Car Sales Marketplace

An online marketplace where private sellers and dealers list used vehicles and buyers search, contact sellers and reserve a vehicle with a deposit. Operates in the EU.

## Functional requirements
FR-01: Buyers can search listings by free text and filter by make, model, year, price range, mileage, fuel type, body type, distance from a postcode and seller type, with the number of matching listings shown next to every filter value.
FR-02: Buyers can open a listing page with up to 40 photos, an optional 360-degree walk-around video and the full vehicle specification.
FR-03: Private sellers and dealers can create, edit, pause and delete their listings.
FR-04: Listing attributes depend on the vehicle category: cars, motorcycles, vans, trucks and caravans each have their own fields (for example payload for vans, number of berths for caravans), and administrators can add categories and fields without a code release.
FR-05: Sellers upload photos and videos; the platform generates thumbnails and web-optimised versions automatically.
FR-06: Buyers can save a search and receive an email or push notification when a new matching listing is published.
FR-07: Buyers can message a seller through in-platform chat; the conversation history is kept per listing.
FR-08: A buyer can reserve a vehicle by paying a refundable deposit by card; the listing is then shown as reserved for 48 hours.
FR-09: If the seller cancels, or the reservation expires without a sale, the deposit is refunded automatically.
FR-10: Dealers can bulk-import and update their inventory from a CSV file or through a REST API feed.
FR-11: The platform checks each listing's VIN with an external vehicle-history provider and shows a summary of the report on the listing.
FR-12: Buyers can request a financing quote from partner lenders directly from the listing page.
FR-13: Buyers and sellers register and sign in with email and password, or with a Google or Apple account.
FR-14: Buyers can review a dealer after a completed purchase.
FR-15: Moderators review listings flagged by users and can suspend a listing or an account.
FR-16: Dealers have a dashboard showing views, saves and enquiries per listing per day.
FR-17: Administrators can view and export the complete history of every deposit payment and refund.
FR-18: When a seller creates a listing, the platform suggests a price range based on comparable vehicles sold on the platform.
FR-19: Users can download a copy of all personal data the platform holds about them.
FR-20: Users can delete their account, after which the platform erases their personal data.

## Non-functional requirements
NFR-01: Search results, including the per-filter counts, are returned within 300 ms at the 95th percentile over at least 2 million active listings.
NFR-02: The platform stores at least 40 TB of photos and video, growing by about 1 TB per month.
NFR-03: Listing photos load within 1 second for users anywhere in Europe.
NFR-04: Deposit payments and refunds are atomic: a deposit is never captured without the listing being reserved, and is never refunded twice.
NFR-05: Every deposit payment, refund and reservation status change is kept in an immutable audit trail for 7 years.
NFR-06: Card data never touches the platform's servers; card payments are processed by a PCI DSS compliant payment provider.
NFR-07: When an account is deleted, the user's personal data is erased from every store, including search indexes, media storage, chat history, caches and backups, within 30 days (GDPR Article 17). Payment records needed for the audit trail are kept but pseudonymised.
NFR-08: The platform supports 5,000 concurrent users and peaks of 300 search requests per second.
NFR-09: Search and listing pages are available 99.9% of each month.
NFR-10: All personal data is stored and processed inside the EU.
NFR-11: Saved-search notifications are delivered within 5 minutes of a matching listing being published.
NFR-12: A dealer feed of up to 10,000 listings is processed within 15 minutes without slowing down search for buyers.
NFR-13: Dealer dashboard statistics may be up to 1 hour old.

requirements_text:
# Car Sales Marketplace

An online marketplace where private sellers and dealers list used vehicles and buyers search, contact sellers and reserve a vehicle with a deposit. Operates in the EU.

## Functional requirements
FR-01: Buyers can search listings by free text and filter by make, model, year, price range, mileage, fuel type, body type, distance from a postcode and seller type, with the number of matching listings shown next to every filter value.
FR-02: Buyers can open a listing page with up to 40 photos, an optional 360-degree walk-around video and the full vehicle specification.
FR-03: Private sellers and dealers can create, edit, pause and delete their listings.
FR-04: Listing attributes depend on the vehicle category: cars, motorcycles, vans, trucks and caravans each have their own fields (for example payload for vans, number of berths for caravans), and administrators can add categories and fields without a code release.
FR-05: Sellers upload photos and videos; the platform generates thumbnails and web-optimised versions automatically.
FR-06: Buyers can save a search and receive an email or push notification when a new matching listing is published.
FR-07: Buyers can message a seller through in-platform chat; the conversation history is kept per listing.
FR-08: A buyer can reserve a vehicle by paying a refundable deposit by card; the listing is then shown as reserved for 48 hours.
FR-09: If the seller cancels, or the reservation expires without a sale, the deposit is refunded automatically.
FR-10: Dealers can bulk-import and update their inventory from a CSV file or through a REST API feed.
FR-11: The platform checks each listing's VIN with an external vehicle-history provider and shows a summary of the report on the listing.
FR-12: Buyers can request a financing quote from partner lenders directly from the listing page.
FR-13: Buyers and sellers register and sign in with email and password, or with a Google or Apple account.
FR-14: Buyers can review a dealer after a completed purchase.
FR-15: Moderators review listings flagged by users and can suspend a listing or an account.
FR-16: Dealers have a dashboard showing views, saves and enquiries per listing per day.
FR-17: Administrators can view and export the complete history of every deposit payment and refund.
FR-18: When a seller creates a listing, the platform suggests a price range based on comparable vehicles sold on the platform.
FR-19: Users can download a copy of all personal data the platform holds about them.
FR-20: Users can delete their account, after which the platform erases their personal data.

## Non-functional requirements
NFR-01: Search results, including the per-filter counts, are returned within 300 ms at the 95th percentile over at least 2 million active listings.
NFR-02: The platform stores at least 40 TB of photos and video, growing by about 1 TB per month.
NFR-03: Listing photos load within 1 second for users anywhere in Europe.
NFR-04: Deposit payments and refunds are atomic: a deposit is never captured without the listing being reserved, and is never refunded twice.
NFR-05: Every deposit payment, refund and reservation status change is kept in an immutable audit trail for 7 years.
NFR-06: Card data never touches the platform's servers; card payments are processed by a PCI DSS compliant payment provider.
NFR-07: When an account is deleted, the user's personal data is erased from every store, including search indexes, media storage, chat history, caches and backups, within 30 days (GDPR Article 17). Payment records needed for the audit trail are kept but pseudonymised.
NFR-08: The platform supports 5,000 concurrent users and peaks of 300 search requests per second.
NFR-09: Search and listing pages are available 99.9% of each month.
NFR-10: All personal data is stored and processed inside the EU.
NFR-11: Saved-search notifications are delivered within 5 minutes of a matching listing being published.
NFR-12: A dealer feed of up to 10,000 listings is processed within 15 minutes without slowing down search for buyers.
NFR-13: Dealer dashboard statistics may be up to 1 hour old.

elements.name: Buyer
elements.responsibility: Searches and filters vehicle listings, requests quotes, secures reservations, and chats with sellers.

elements.name: Private Seller
elements.responsibility: Creates and updates vehicle listings, uploads media, chats with buyers, and manages sales.

elements.name: Dealer
elements.responsibility: Manages large inventory, reviews daily views/sales stats, handles customer reservations, and imports listing feeds.

elements.name: Moderator / Admin
elements.responsibility: Reviews flagged listings, manages vehicle categories and custom attributes, and reviews financial histories.

elements.name: Marketplace Web Portal
elements.responsibility: Responsive web app allowing users to search, view listing specs, upload media, pay deposits, and chat.

elements.name: Admin & Moderator Portal
elements.responsibility: Provides administration tools to manage taxonomy, review flagged content, and audit payments.

elements.name: API Gateway
elements.responsibility: Acts as the single entry point to route client traffic, enforce authentication tokens, and rate-limit public API feeds.

elements.name: Marketplace Service API
elements.responsibility: Handles core business logic, including listing CRUD, user profile management, history verification orchestrations, and reviews.

elements.name: Payment & Reservation Service
elements.responsibility: Coordinates atomic transactions, handles webhook verification from payment processors, and manages 48-hour reservation timers.

elements.name: Chat Service
elements.responsibility: Provides WebSocket connection endpoints for in-app instant messaging and archives conversation histories.

elements.name: Feed Import Worker
elements.responsibility: Ingests and parses bulky CSV and REST API feeds in chunks asynchronously to avoid database locks.

elements.name: Media Processing Worker
elements.responsibility: Subscribes to raw media uploads, processes them into optimized resolutions, and writes thumbnails back to object storage.

elements.name: Saved Search Notification Worker
elements.responsibility: Monitors new listings and matches them against saved-search criteria to dispatch emails and push alerts.

elements.name: Primary Database
elements.responsibility: Houses transactional schemas, dynamic JSONB fields for custom listing categories, immutable ledger tables, and user profile registries.

elements.name: Search Engine
elements.responsibility: Performs fast geospatial, free-text, and faceted aggregation queries with near real-time statistics.

elements.name: Chat Store
elements.responsibility: Stores unstructured messages sequentially associated with listing conversation threads.

elements.name: Analytics & Statistics Database
elements.responsibility: Aggregates events on daily views, saves, and inquiries to enable analytical dealer graphs and comparative price generation.

elements.name: Object Storage
elements.responsibility: Stores multi-terabyte raw and processed images/videos with strict lifecycle security rules.

elements.name: Message Queue & Event Broker
elements.responsibility: Decouples transaction webhooks, background image tasks, and feed ingestion queues to run in parallel.

elements.name: CDN Cache
elements.responsibility: Caches web-optimised image thumbnails and videos locally to reduce latency under 1 second.

elements.name: Auth0 / Apple / Google Auth
elements.responsibility: Handles federated sign-in requests, security controls, and initial JWT issue.

elements.name: Stripe API
elements.responsibility: Processes card credentials outside platform servers securely to comply with PCI-DSS guidelines.

elements.name: Vehicle History Provider API
elements.responsibility: Checks incoming vehicle VIN tags to verify chronological background status report summaries.

elements.name: Partner Finance Lenders Integration
elements.responsibility: Processes direct applications for financing quotes and terms feedback on the UI context.

elements.name: Email Notification Provider
elements.responsibility: Delivers dynamic search updates and customer system notification templates.
